1.0.2: Converted all card, booster pack, booster box, and accessory images from PNG to WEBP format.
Updated all image URLs in configs, card definitions, and client code to use .webp extensions.
Optimized assets image folder and configuration to reflect new image format.
Reduced total local image size from 306MB to 25MB with no quality loss.
Updated entire script, including all configs and asset references, for full consistency.
1.0.3: Fixed an issue where cards were not saving correctly within the binder.
Improved layout animation transitions for a smoother user experience.
Enhanced the visual quality and rendering of card displays.
Improved effect movement synchronization with card positioning.
Fixed incorrect bridge function logic to ensure proper integration.
UPDATE ALL FILES - The config can be dragged and dropped, as no changes have been made to the config.
1.0.5: Added a full Trading Card Shop NUI with categories, cart, and one-click checkout.
Added server-side basket checkout (grouped items, price calculation, inventory space checks, and auto-refund on add failure).
Added Trading Card Exchange / Kiosk (TC Machine) UI (Buy Packs + Sell Collection screens).
Added configurable TC Machine prop + locations (toggle via Config.TcMachine.enabled).
Improved client-side action rate limiting for shop basket checkout to reduce spam.
Improved shop purchase validation (rejects unavailable items and enforces cooldown checks per item).
Security: Added a hard server-side limit for basket size to prevent DoS (Config.Shop.maxBasketItems, default 30).
Added new item `empty_grading_case` this items is needed to get you card graded now make sore you add new item to you inventory.
1.0.6: Replaced all 'PSA' branding with 'CVG' (Card Value Grading) across the entire script, items, UI, and locales.
Updated Grading UI to use a rich metallic gold color (#D4AF37) for the grading score circle.
Fixed a critical issue where cards could not be removed from the binder after a server restart.
Improved binder data handling to automatically normalize card positions (fixing legacy data issues).
Updated all locale files, and specifically updated item descriptions for 'grading_case' and 'empty_grading_case' in installation lists (OX/QB) to replace 'PSA' with 'CVG'.
Redesigned Shop and Buy UIs for a more modern look and smoother user experience.
Enhanced Grading Shop UI with updated visuals and improved interaction flows.
Upgraded TC Machine interface for intuitive card exchange and pack purchasing.
UPDATE ALL FILES - Significant changes to UI files (HTML/CSS/JS) and Server logic.
1.0.7: Split config into config.lua (core), configcards.lua (cards), and configshop.lua (shops/pricing); ensured fxmanifest loads in correct order.
Rebalanced Sell Shop base prices: large reductions for Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary across all brands.
Implemented pity-off booster pack rarity targeting: Epic ≈ 1/2000, Legendary ≈ 1/3000, Holo ≈ 1/4000, OriginalArt ≈ 1/5000.
Enabled OriginalArt as an independent rarity bucket on the server for selection and rules.
Updated global BoosterPacks cardsrarityRules to use direct weights for Epic/Legendary/Holo/OriginalArt (packGate disabled for these).
Kept Rare using packGate=true with chance=1% to preserve intended rare gating behavior.
Renamed non-card item names and image references to remove 'trading_cards_' prefix (cards unchanged).
1.0.8: CRITICAL hotfix: Updated server.lua and client.lua ONLY.
No other files were changed in this update.
Fixed an issue where card metadata was not being applied correctly in certain cases.
Important for ESX + ox_inventory users: existing cards without metadata must be removed.
Cards missing metadata can be identified by the lack of a % condition when hovering over the item in inventory.
Cards without metadata may cause unexpected issues with the Trading Card Book.
Newly obtained cards after this update will correctly apply metadata.
Apologies for the inconvenience — applying this fix is required to prevent further issues.
1.0.9: Added `Config.BindersEnforceBrand` (default: true). When enabled, binders will only accept cards that match the binder's assigned brand.
Added `Config.BindersDuplicatesCheck` (default: true). Prevents adding duplicate cards (same name) to the binder.
Added `Config.BindersChecklistEnabled` (default: true). Displays a checklist of cards in the book on the last page [20].
Updated `Config.Binders` table to include a `brand` parameter for each binder, enabling brand-specific card restrictions.
Added Live Checklist Updates: The binder checklist now automatically updates in real-time when cards are added.
Fixed an issue where card animations (sway, reveal) were not playing for users with 'reduce motion' enabled in Windows settings.
General performance improvements and code optimizations.
1.1.0: Fixed unclickable sell buttons on TC Machine UI by resolving CSS overlay issues (z-index conflicts).
Reorganized webhook configuration: merged separate 'Endpoints' and 'Colors' tables into a single 'DiscordHook' table for cleaner management.
Renamed webhook configuration table from 'Endpoints' to 'DiscordHook' across the entire script for consistency.
Added comprehensive Fivemanage logging integration alongside existing Discord webhooks.
Added configurable toggles in webhooks.lua: 'DiscordWebhooks', 'FivemanageWebhooks', and 'FivemanageDataset'.
Implemented automatic player identifier detection and metadata formatting for Fivemanage logs.
Added error handling for Fivemanage logging to prevent script crashes if the fmsdk resource is unavailable.
Enhanced webhook emission logic to support simultaneous logging to both Discord and Fivemanage, or either service independently.
Improved debug logging for webhook failures, including detailed error messages for troubleshooting.
All webhook payloads now include structured metadata for better log organization and filtering in external services.
